notes: GAAP county. Governmental receipts/disbursements/transfers/fund balances from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (Total Governmental Funds, trimmed pp7-8). Transfers in and out both 21,131,803; other_financing is printed sale of capital assets 671,183. Taxes (120,655,538) kept as taxes (unlabeled): Statement of Activities (p4) lists taxes by type totaling 120,885,901 (government-wide accrual basis), which does not tie, so no split. Other income 3,762,040 (p7) split into Keno fund proceeds 1,882,957 (keno/lottery, p20) and the remainder 1,879,083 (other, review). Only internal service funds exist (pp9-11); no enterprise funds, so business_type is null and internal service fund data is not added to governmental totals (proprietary cash flow recorded from p11). Balance sheet uses the government-wide Statement of Net Position (Governmental Activities column is the only column, pp2-3); deferred charge on refunding categorized as other assets within deferred outflows. ending_cash is the governmental funds Balance Sheet cash, including investments (p5), 100,946,217. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budgetary-basis budget schedule (pp12-14, departments, function totals only, budgetary basis so actuals differ from GAAP statement; the General Fund column of the combining schedule p19 is not recorded to avoid double counting). The Veterans Aid and Broadband sub-funds are recorded in detail from their own budgetary-basis budget schedules (re-trimmed pp22-23, replacing the p19 combining-schedule columns used before): Veterans Aid client services 13,049 (GAAP 11,003 on p19) and transfers in 20,000; Broadband contracted services 62,572, miscellaneous fees 0 (budget 100,000) and transfers in 100,000. These transfers in (120,000) match the General Fund transfers out included in the 17,391,239 budget-schedule figure (statement 17,271,239 after the 120,000 elimination, p19). Highway and Federal Grants Funds from their budget schedules (budgetary basis). Federal Grants function assigned public safety as a guess (statement shows 13.4M public safety). Nonmajor funds recorded as Total column only (p21; 18 fund columns on pp20-21); its Other income 2,031,461 split into Keno 1,882,957 (keno/lottery) and the other funds 148,504 (miscellaneous), as in the top-level receipts. Beginning cash not shown for governmental funds. Read pages 1-25 of 25
